confirm.title: Add Phomemo T02
confirm.description:
Set up the Phomemo T02 at {address}?

The printer must be powered on to print. It sleeps to save battery, and Home Assistant cannot wake it.

user.title: Add Phomemo T02
user.description: Choose the printer to add. It must be switched on to appear here.

abort.already_configured: This printer is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Phomemo T02 was found. Switch the printer on and make sure it is in range of a Bluetooth adapter, or of an ESPHome proxy with active connections enabled.

init.title: Bluetooth tuning
init.description: Defaults suit a local Bluetooth adapter. If prints come out garbled or time out over an ESPHome proxy, lower the chunk size or raise the delay.

data_description.chunk_size: Capped automatically at the negotiated MTU minus 3.
data_description.chunk_delay_ms: Raise this first if prints are garbled.
data_description.idle_disconnect_s: Frees a connection slot on the Bluetooth proxy between prints.

print.name: Print
print.description: Render an imagespec payload and print it.

height.name: Height
height.description: Fixed height in dots; omit to auto-crop.

print_text.name: Print text
print_text.description: Print a line of text, word-wrapped to the paper width.

print_qr.name: Print QR code
print_qr.description: Print a QR code with an optional caption.

data.name: Data
data.description: String encoded into the QR code.
